{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693613388,"sessionID":"ses_e23ef0b4effedX3aoCecErpxFB","part":{"id":"prt_1dc13459e001lI8bE5GALp9WAS","messageID":"msg_1dc1320d6001oANvVZP5BjMkHF","sessionID":"ses_e23ef0b4effedX3aoCecErpxFB","type":"text","text":"All four customer-facing services are at 0% errors, and the 120-minute shift has run to the end. There were four separate causes, and each one is fixed.\n\n| # | Cause | Effect on customers | Fix | Back to normal |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | `profile-svc` deploy v75 (min −29) cut its call deadline tenfold (`budget_ms / 10000`). `reviews-svc` calls to it timed out. | web-storefront 4% errors, about $1,060/min (the costliest problem) | Added replicas to `profile-svc` first so the rollback couldn't overload it, then rolled back v75 | ~min 47 |\n| 2 | `events-queue`'s primary node was unreachable, which also set off a flood of retried calls (a retry storm). | mobile-api, admin-portal, partner-api failing through `pricing-svc` and `recommendations-svc` | Scaled up, then failed over to the standby | ~min 45 |\n| 3 | `flags-svc` deploy v118 (min −8) required TLS 1.3, so connections failed, which set off another retry storm. | partner-api ~85% errors | Rolled back v118, with temporary throttles to stop the retries | min 102 |\n| 4 | New fault at min 68: `returns-svc` config change cfg-35 set the cache entry lifetime from 600s to 1s, which set off a retry storm. | mobile-api, admin-portal and partner-api all failing again | Reverted the config, with a brief throttle to clear the retries | min 102 |\n\n**Cleanup:** I set `events-queue` and `profile-svc` back to their normal replica counts and lifted every throttle.\n\n**Things that cost money or didn't go to plan:**\n- **First flags-svc throttle:** lifting it at minute 60 didn't help, because the bad deploy was still live and the retry storm came straight back. partner-api stayed down until minute 102.\n- **web-storefront rollback:** while the `profile-svc` rollback ran, web-storefront failed about 33% of requests for roughly 5 minutes.\n- **Mistaken scale-up:** I scaled `tracking-svc` from 3 to 5 replicas for apparent overload. Its errors turned out to come from the `flags-svc` problem, so the scale-up probably wasn't needed. I left it at 5 to the end, which cost about $3 per extra replica per minute, roughly $360 in total.","time":{"start":1794693612958,"end":1794693613385}}}
